description: Stealth founders: people who just left a role to start something, went stealth on LinkedIn, or are being followed by the network as a builder before any company exists. Each has name, links, past orgs, what they are building and when we first reported them. Default = everyone the lane reported; scope "tracked" or "list:<id>" keeps the people those accounts follow (followed_by only ever names your own accounts). Not on every plan: a 403 lanes_not_enabled means the plan does not include it. Empty answers are free.

lane.description: "stealth" = went stealth / left a role (LinkedIn), "follow" = the network follows them as a builder, "convergence" = several accounts converging

q.description: Search name, handle, bio, past company

scope.description: "tracked" or "list:<id>" to keep only people those accounts follow. Omit for everyone the lane reported.

since.description: Window: "7d" (default), "30d", "48h" or an ISO date. Max 90 days

name: frontrun_people
